value.rationale: The originating recent paper motivates GD as projection-data critical complexity and computes ED for scroll rulings, leaving the natural GD count in this family unaddressed. The exact infinite family identifies when ED and GD coincide, with substantive geometry explaining the absence of cut-critical points. It is not a restatement of the ED formula.
